entities.summary: Franz Josef Karl Edler von Matsch, also known as Franz Matsch, was an Austrian painter and sculptor in the Jugendstil style. Along with Gustav and Ernst Klimt, he was a member of the Maler-Companie. He painted Achilles in Achillion Museum in Corfu.
